ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are three horizontal parallel lines, and a straight line slanting from lower left to upper right successively intersects them. At the bottommost intersection point, angle 142° is marked below the lower horizontal line, and angle (2y+8)° is marked above the same lower horizontal line; these two angles share the horizontal ray to the right, and the other two sides are opposite rays on the same oblique transversal. Reasoning: Therefore these two angles form a linear pair and are supplementary angles, so (2y+8)+142=180. Solving gives 2y+8=38, 2y=30, y=15.
